title: Move-Out Billing Standard — Final Month Proration and the Fee End Date (Independent Living)
content:
## Standard

**S1.** Once a notice of termination stands on a residency under the Independent Living Residency Agreement and the resident or the resident's representative asks to settle the residency, the base fee charge of the final month is posted on that day, the final month being the calendar month after the last month already billed.

**S2.** The final month's base fee charge is the monthly service fee in effect before the final month, as billed on the latest full-month base fee charge, divided by 30 (the proration basis in days) and multiplied by the days from the first day of the final month through the fee end date, counted inclusive of both days, and rounded once to the cent half up.

**S3.** The fee end date is the later of the vacate date — or, before the apartment is surrendered, the intended vacate date stated on the notice — and the notice date plus the move-out notice period of the apartment type in calendar days.

**S4.** No final month's base fee charge is posted when the fee end date falls on or before the last day already billed.

## Terms

- **Last day already billed** — the latest service-to date among the base fee charges on the residency ledger.
- **Latest full-month base fee charge** — the most recent base fee charge billed for a whole calendar month; its amount is the monthly service fee in effect before the final month.
- **Proration basis** — 30 days for every final month, whatever the number of days in that calendar month.

## Worked example (hypothetical residency, 30-day move-out notice period)

Base fees billed through March 31; latest full-month base fee charge 4,000.00; notice dated March 20; intended vacate date April 5; apartment not yet surrendered.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Notice date plus 30 days | April 19 |
| Later of April 5 and April 19 | Fee end date April 19 |
| Final month | April |
| Days April 1 through April 19 | 19 |
| 4,000.00 divided by 30, multiplied by 19 | 2,533.3333… |
| Rounded once to the cent | 2,533.33 |

## Boundary case

Notice dated February 10 under a 30-day notice period, apartment vacated March 15, base fees billed through March 31: the fee end date is the later of March 15 and March 12, that is March 15, which falls on or before the last day already billed, so no final month's base fee charge is posted.
